name: mcp-server-andru-intelligence
description: Operational empathy for technical founders + PE/VC operators navigating high-stakes B2B interactions. 28 MCP tools + CLI: ICP scoring, persona simulation, battlecards, deal classification, prospect discovery, investor matching, founder wellness, plus market signals, company revenue-readiness scoring, portfolio rollups/briefs, and natural-language consultation with Andru's domain agents. Every result is cryptographically signed (verify against /.well-known/jwks.json).
author: Andru (H&S)

scripts.prepublishOnly: node --input-type=module -e "import {tools} from './src/catalog.js'; if(!tools?.length) {console.error('No tools in catalog'); process.exit(1)} console.log('Catalog OK:', tools.length, 'tools')"
